description:
Iris is a 62ft Majesty flybridge motor yacht available for private charter in Dubai, offering a Majesty 62 for cruising the waters of Dubai in complete comfort.

She welcomes up to 25 guests, has one cabin and is run by a professional crew of 2. Departing from Dubai Marina, she is a great choice for birthdays, family days and groups of friends, with routes past Bluewaters, Ain Dubai, the Palm Jumeirah and the Burj Al Arab.

Charters are available by the hour, for sunset cruises or for the full day. Contact Yacht Research for availability, routes and a tailored quote.
